gw_ifwatch.head: GW inbound {kind} ({iface})
gw_ifwatch.recreated: {head}: interface recreated {when} (ifindex {was} → {now}) — {clients} clients reconnect on their own in 15–25 s; by: {who}{tail}
gw_ifwatch.reset: {head}: client sessions reset without recreating the interface {when} ({n} of {total}: counters dropped to zero) — they reconnect on their own in 15–25 s; by: {who}{tail}
gw_ifwatch.started_times: {head}: since boot, service {unit} started {times} ({starts}) — each restart costs {clients} clients up to 15–25 s; by: {who}{tail}
gw_ifwatch.who_bypassed: the service did not restart — the interface was recreated around it (an ip link command not run by Kaskad, or the amneziawg module was unloaded)
gw_ifwatch.who_not_kaskad: Kaskad did not restart it — systemd or a systemctl command not run by Kaskad (journalctl -b -u {unit})
gw_ifwatch.who_not_set: Kaskad did not change the settings — an awg/wg set or setconf command not run by Kaskad
gw_ifwatch.who_restarted: service {unit} started again ({starts}), Kaskad did not restart it — systemd or a systemctl command not run by Kaskad (journalctl -b -u {unit})
